name: Inventory
note: The installer (bin/app_install.php, step 'registry') writes mcp/registries/inventory.json in the kernel from this file's `resolve` block plus mcp/action_registry.json. Each resolve tool, called with `q` alone (digits = an id, else exact on a number / SKU / GTIN, else ILIKE or trigram, at most 6 candidates), answers its normal envelope {"ok": true, "count", "rows": [...]} and the kernel reads `rows` (application_actions.resolve_via_mcp accepts rows, candidates, results, items); every row carries id_field and label_field. The tools are the Phase 1 tool surface's names (docs/inventory-mcp-tool-surface.md, 'Entity resolution for the action tools'); Phase 4 builds them (mcp/records_server.py). Every record is bigint-keyed. A repeated param (lines, variants, quantities) is a list of ids or objects, never resolved by name; lines, shipments, payments, receipts, transfers, adjustments, counts, identifiers, images, watches, proposals, credentials, pulls, feed keys, price lists, dispatches, notifications, tokens, attachments, notes, templates, product types, reason codes and tax rates are ids or keys only.
